info.title: ShopVerse E-Commerce API
info.description:
Production-grade E-Commerce REST API built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Redis.

## Authentication
This API uses **JWT Bearer tokens** for authentication.

1. Register via `POST /auth/signup`
2. Verify your email via `GET /auth/verify-email?token=...`
3. Login via `POST /auth/login` — receives `accessToken` in response body and `refreshToken` in HTTP-only cookie
4. Include `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` header on protected routes
5. Use `POST /auth/refresh-token` when access token expires (reads refresh token from cookie)

## Security Features
- Helmet security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
- CORS whitelist-based origin control
- MongoDB injection sanitization
- XSS input sanitization
- HTTP Parameter Pollution protection
- Rate limiting: 200 req/15min global, 10 req/15min auth, 5 req/hr password reset
- Gzip compression on all responses ≥ 1KB

## Rate Limiting Headers
Every response includes:
- `RateLimit-Limit` – max requests allowed
- `RateLimit-Remaining` – remaining requests in window
- `RateLimit-Reset` – UTC epoch timestamp when window resets

## Error Response Format
All errors follow this structure:
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "statusCode": 400,
  "errorCode": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "message": "Human-readable description",
  "details": { "field": "email", "issue": "Invalid email address" }
}
```

## Cache Headers
Cached endpoints return `X-Cache: HIT` or `X-Cache: MISS` response headers.
